subject: Vendor parity request and proposed replacement packaging
messages:
From: Anne Park <anne.park@helixsys.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: pricing parity + migration packaging (Helix RFP attached)

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking a look. We're running a procurement review at Helix Systems and evaluating a potential replacement of our incumbent inference vendor (CloudWeave). Attached is our RFP (Helix_RFP_v2.pdf) with current run-rate, seat counts, and basic SLA asks.

High-level asks: 
- Can Redwood match or come within 5% of our current blended unit economics for inference tokens at our annualized run-rate?
- If not, what packaging (credits, onboarding, guaranteed throughput) would you propose to make the economics neutral to Helix during a 12-month transition?
- What migration credits, professional services hours, and timeline would you offer for an enterprise switch?

We want a concise commercial proposal and a short migration plan — nothing overly legal yet. Connor suggested you might be the right point to coordinate.

Target timeline: decision window two weeks from now (by 2026-09-24).

Appreciate a quick read and any clarifying questions.

Best,
Anne Park
Head of Procurement, Helix Systems
procurement@helixsys.com

Attachment: Helix_RFP_v2.pdf (3 pages, RFP summary)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Anne Park <anne.park@helixsys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pricing parity + migration packaging (Helix RFP attached)

Anne — thanks for sending the RFP and the clear asks. We're interested in moving quickly on this. A few clarifying questions before we build a proposal: 

1) Current spend profile: can you confirm the trailing-3-month token volume and the 90th-percentile per-request p95 latency requirement? The RFP gave an annualized figure but the shape matters for batching/quantization recommendations.
2) Are there hard constraints on data residency or on-prem workloads in scope for the pilot?
3) Any required contract language (mandatory indemnities, termination rights) that would materially affect pricing?

Quick snapshot of our commercial levers (so you know what to expect):
- Upfront credits vs pure consumption discount (mixable)
- Migration credits (one-time, applied during onboarding) and packaged PS hours for model validation
- SLA uplift / uptime credits for commercially material targets

I'll ask Naomi to run two side-by-side packaging options based on the RFP numbers: a pure parity match (lift-and-shift credits) and a phased bundle (onboard credits + tiered discounts). Connor can then take the external-facing proposal to you.

Can we set a 30-min call Thursday 09/15 to walk the proposal and agree a mutual action plan? Proposed times: 09:00, 13:00, 16:00 PT.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0142

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing math + two packaging proposals for Helix (TCO worksheet attached)

Markus / team — attached is the TCO-worksheet-helix.xlsx (tabbed assumptions + sensitivity). High-level summary below; numbers use the run-rate and seat split from Helix_RFP_v2.pdf and assume 12-month ramp.

Option A — Lift-and-shift parity (fast path)
- Fixed components: guaranteed reserved throughput for peak windows; annual commitment = $1,200,000
- Consumption discount: 12% off our public per-token list for first 12 months
- One-time migration credit: $140,000 (applied as bill credit)
- PS hours: 120 hours (model porting + perf validation), included
- Estimated net-first-year cost to Helix (after credits): $1,050,000 (approx. 3% lower than incumbent run-rate)

Tradeoffs: quickest to close (2–4 weeks), limited long-term value capture for Redwood, minimal implementation customization.

Option B — Phased bundle with onboarding acceleration (preferred for retention)
- Year 1: blended bundle = $950,000 (includes 200k pre-purchased inference units + priority routing credits)
- Onboarding credit: $200,000 applied over first 3 invoices to offset migration costs
- SLA uplift: 99.95% guaranteed for production tier, with graduated outage crediting
- Technical success package: 200 PS hours + two on-site (or remote) workshops
- Estimated net-first-year cost to Helix: $1,025,000 but with higher operational guarantees and lower friction to migrate

Recommended ask (deal structuring):
- Use Option B as anchor (better product fit) and offer Option A as an expedited close at parity if Helix needs the fastest timeline.
- Concession plan: if legal redlines require additional vendor liability, reserve a small commercial buffer (up to $75k credits) and tie to a 12-month minimum commitment.

Risks/notes:
- The incumbent has an existing egress credit structure we can't fully replicate; recommended to offer migration credits + temporary ingress egress waiver for the first 90 days.
- If Helix insists on consumption-only (no committed spend), we can't do the same discount depth; would propose a higher per-token price with volume tiers.

Attachments: TCO-worksheet-helix.xlsx (detailed assumptions), internal pricing model

Naomi Feldman
Senior Pricing Analyst, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Anne Park <anne.park@helixsys.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pricing parity + migration packaging (proposal attached)

Anne — thanks again for the RFP and for the quick turn. Attaching our proposal packet (Helix_Redwood_Proposal_v1.pdf) plus the TCO worksheet Naomi created. Topline summary:

- Anchor option (Option B, phased bundle): 12-month blended package at $950k with $200k onboarding credit; SLA 99.95%; 200 PS hours.
- Fast-path parity (Option A): parity-like structure with $140k migration credit and 12% consumption discount — closes faster but with smaller retention levers.

What we need from Helix to finalize commercials:
1) Confirmation of trailing 3-month token volumes (CSV or GCP/AWS billing extracts).
2) A short list of non-negotiable legal terms (if any) beyond our standard SOW.
3) Preferred decision date and any procurement approvals required internally.

Next step: propose a 30-min commercial + technical sync on Thursday 2026-09-16 at 10:00 PT. If that works, we'll bring a redlined term summary and a pre-filled DocuSign for signature.
